summary: Sunset Man is the second studio album by American country singer James Otto, released April 8, 2008 on Warner Bros. Records. Its lead single, "Just Got Started Lovin' You", reached Number One on Billboard's Hot Country Songs chart in May 2008. The follow-up singles "For You" and "These Are the Good Ole Days" both peaked in the mid-30s, and the album had sold 389,000 copies by May 2010 per Nielsen SoundScan.
